data.long_meaning: The name Goodman is derived from the Old English words 'god' meaning 'good' and 'man' meaning 'man' or 'person'. This name was given to individuals who were considered good providers or had a good reputation in their community. It was also used as a nickname for those who were known for their good character and morals.
